payload.title: Generic webhook channel: designed, not built
payload.description:
**Milestone:** Backlog

**Goal.** Design only, recorded in docs/notifications-plan.md: an HTTPS POST of the delivery as JSON through the `Channel` interface, signed like Slack's scheme with a per-connection secret, retried by the same queues, with an admin setting the URL. SSRF checks on the URL are the main work. Build when someone asks.

**Acceptance.**
Remains in backlog until requested.
